name: 陳彥安
objective:
本課程的主要目的在教授學生機器學習、大數據等人工智慧技術，並使用在物聯網的創新與應用上。課程內容包括：人工智慧概論、大數據方法、機器學習方法、資料探勘方法、最佳化方法、物聯網概論、影音處理、雲端技術、物聯網系統實作等。
Internet of Things (IoT) serves as the framework for collecting data and control devices in real-life, while artificial intelligence (AI) provides many algorithms that enable machines to think. As a result, AI and IoT are inseparable when building an intelligent system. This course will introduce the components of IoT and AI through hands-on experiments, covering the use of edge devices, sensor information collection, device actuation, and sensor data analysis, ultimately leading to the creation of an AIoT application. Furthermore, this course is project-oriented, and students will need to use the knowledge gained from lab experiments and develop a project that involves virtual computing and physical interaction.
